```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(gprofiler2)
library(patchwork)

select <- dplyr::select

# Shared colour palette for dissertation figures
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_colours.rda"))
```

```{r establish-pc-directions}
# Establish biological direction of PC1/PC2 by correlating sample-level
# PC scores with mean cell volume. PC1 vs volume: Spearman r = -0.216,
# so PC1 reflects TOR/PKA signalling state rather than cell size
# (PC1_TOP = active signalling, PC1_BOTTOM = inhibited). PC2 vs volume:
# Spearman r = +0.795, so PC2 is the primary cell size axis (PC2_TOP =
# large cells, PC2_BOTTOM = small cells).
pca_samples <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_samples_AC.txt"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE)

pc_vol_cor <- pca_samples %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_cell_volume)) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_PC1_vol = cor(PC1, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman"),
    cor_PC2_vol = cor(PC2, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman")
  )

cat("PC1 vs cell volume (Spearman r):", round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC1_vol, 3), "\n")
cat("PC2 vs cell volume (Spearman r):", round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC2_vol, 3), "\n")
```

```{r load-data}
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

pca_genes_long <- pca_genes %>%
  select(gene_id, PC1, PC2) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(PC1, PC2), names_to = "PC", values_to = "score")

all_genes_universe <- pca_genes$gene_id
```

```{r filter-top-bottom-10pct}
# Top/bottom 10% of PC1 and PC2 separately, matching scripts 01/02
get_top_bottom_10pct <- function(df, pc_name) {
  df_pc <- df %>% filter(PC == pc_name)
  n <- nrow(df_pc)
  cutoff_n <- ceiling(n * 0.1)
  top    <- df_pc %>% slice_max(score, n = cutoff_n) %>% pull(gene_id)
  bottom <- df_pc %>% slice_min(score, n = cutoff_n) %>% pull(gene_id)
  list(top = top, bottom = bottom)
}

pc1_genes <- get_top_bottom_10pct(pca_genes_long, "PC1")
pc2_genes <- get_top_bottom_10pct(pca_genes_long, "PC2")

cat("PC1 top 10%:", length(pc1_genes$top),
    "genes | bottom 10%:", length(pc1_genes$bottom), "genes\n")
cat("PC2 top 10%:", length(pc2_genes$top),
    "genes | bottom 10%:", length(pc2_genes$bottom), "genes\n")
```

```{r run-enrichment-function}
# gProfiler wrapper. correction_method = "g_SCS" accounts for GO term
# hierarchy (parent-child dependencies), more appropriate than BH for
# GO. exclude_iea = TRUE removes electronically inferred annotations,
# keeping only experimentally validated GO assignments. custom_bg is
# the PCA gene universe, avoiding inflated significance from unobserved
# genes in a genome-wide background.
run_gprofiler <- function(gene_list, universe, label) {
  result <- gost(
    query             = gene_list,
    organism          = "scerevisiae",
    sources           = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC"),
    custom_bg         = universe,
    correction_method = "g_SCS",
    user_threshold    = 0.05,
    exclude_iea       = TRUE,
    significant       = TRUE,
    multi_query       = FALSE
  )

  if (is.null(result)) {
    cat(label, "- no significant terms found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  df <- result$result
  cat(label, "-", nrow(df), "enriched terms\n")
  cat("  BP:", sum(df$source == "GO:BP"),
      "| MF:", sum(df$source == "GO:MF"),
      "| CC:", sum(df$source == "GO:CC"), "\n")
  df
}
```

```{r run-all}
gp_pc1_top    <- run_gprofiler(pc1_genes$top,    all_genes_universe, "PC1 top 10%")
gp_pc1_bottom <- run_gprofiler(pc1_genes$bottom, all_genes_universe, "PC1 bottom 10%")
gp_pc2_top    <- run_gprofiler(pc2_genes$top,    all_genes_universe, "PC2 top 10%")
gp_pc2_bottom <- run_gprofiler(pc2_genes$bottom, all_genes_universe, "PC2 bottom 10%")
```

```{r plot-function}
# Single-panel dot plot: top 10 terms per GO namespace (reduced from
# 20 for compactness in a side-by-side layout).
plot_gprofiler_panel <- function(df, panel_label, direction_label) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  df_top <- df %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    slice_min(p_value, n = 10) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Description_short = truncate_wrap_description(term_name, trunc_width = 40, wrap_width = 30),
      Description_short = fct_reorder(Description_short, -log10(p_value)),
      neg_log10_p = -log10(p_value),
      source      = factor(source,
                           levels = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC"))
    )

  ggplot(df_top, aes(x = neg_log10_p, y = Description_short,
                     size = intersection_size, color = source)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~source, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "GO:BP" = project_colours[["blue"]],
      "GO:MF" = project_colours[["red"]],
      "GO:CC" = project_colours[["purple"]]
    )) +
    labs(
      tag   = panel_label,
      x     = expression(-log[10]("p-value")),
      y     = direction_label,
      size  = "Intersection\nsize",
      color = "GO namespace"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 7, face = "italic",
                                     color = "grey40"),
      strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
      plot.tag        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 7)
    )
}
```

```{r figure-pc1, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Figure: PC1, top 10% (panel A) vs bottom 10% (panel B), side by side
p_a <- plot_gprofiler_panel(
  gp_pc1_top, "A",
  paste0("Top 10% PC1 (n = ", length(pc1_genes$top),
         ") — active TOR/PKA signalling")
)

p_b <- plot_gprofiler_panel(
  gp_pc1_bottom, "B",
  paste0("Bottom 10% PC1 (n = ", length(pc1_genes$bottom),
         ") — TOR/PKA-inhibited state")
)

fig_pc1 <- (p_a | p_b) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "GO enrichment of PC1 gene sets (gProfiler)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "PC1 vs cell volume: Spearman r = ",
      round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC1_vol, 3),
      "  |  PC1 reflects TOR/PKA signalling state, not cell size"
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40", hjust = 0)
    )
  ) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(fig_pc1)
```

```{r figure-pc2, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Figure: PC2, top 10% (panel A) vs bottom 10% (panel B), side by side
p_c <- plot_gprofiler_panel(
  gp_pc2_top, "A",
  paste0("Top 10% PC2 (n = ", length(pc2_genes$top),
         ") — upregulated in large cells")
)

p_d <- plot_gprofiler_panel(
  gp_pc2_bottom, "B",
  paste0("Bottom 10% PC2 (n = ", length(pc2_genes$bottom),
         ") — upregulated in small cells")
)

fig_pc2 <- (p_c | p_d) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "GO enrichment of PC2 gene sets (gProfiler)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "PC2 vs cell volume: Spearman r = ",
      round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC2_vol, 3),
      "  |  PC2 is the primary cell size axis"
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40", hjust = 0)
    )
  ) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(fig_pc2)
```

```{r save-outputs}
save_if_not_null <- function(df, path) {
  if (!is.null(df)) write_tsv(df, path)
}

save_if_not_null(gp_pc1_top,
                 file.path(output_dir, "go_gprofiler_pc1_top10pct.txt"))
save_if_not_null(gp_pc1_bottom,
                 file.path(output_dir, "go_gprofiler_pc1_bottom10pct.txt"))
save_if_not_null(gp_pc2_top,
                 file.path(output_dir, "go_gprofiler_pc2_top10pct.txt"))
save_if_not_null(gp_pc2_bottom,
                 file.path(output_dir, "go_gprofiler_pc2_bottom10pct.txt"))

if (!is.null(fig_pc1)) {
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "figure_gprofiler_pc1.png"),
         plot = fig_pc1, width = 14, height = 10)
}

if (!is.null(fig_pc2)) {
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "figure_gprofiler_pc2.png"),
         plot = fig_pc2, width = 14, height = 10)
}

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
